scripts.zk:ptau: snarkjs powersoftau new bn128 12 ./build/$CIRCUIT/pot12_0000.ptau -v && snarkjs powersoftau contribute ./build/$CIRCUIT/pot12_0000.ptau ./build/$CIRCUIT/pot12_0001.ptau --name='first' -v && snarkjs powersoftau prepare phase2 ./build/$CIRCUIT/pot12_0001.ptau ./build/$CIRCUIT/pot12_final.ptau -v
scripts.zk:setup: snarkjs groth16 setup ./build/$CIRCUIT/$CIRCUIT.r1cs ./build/$CIRCUIT/pot12_final.ptau ./build/$CIRCUIT/circuit_0000.zkey && snarkjs zkey contribute ./build/$CIRCUIT/circuit_0000.zkey ./build/$CIRCUIT/circuit_final.zkey --name='1st contributor' -v && snarkjs zkey export verificationkey ./build/$CIRCUIT/circuit_final.zkey ./build/$CIRCUIT/verification_key.json
scripts.zk:prep: npm run zk:compile && npm run zk:ptau && npm run zk:setup
scripts.zk:prove: snarkjs groth16 prove ./build/$CIRCUIT/circuit_final.zkey ./build/$CIRCUIT/witness.wtns ./build/$CIRCUIT/proof.json ./build/$CIRCUIT/public.json && snarkjs groth16 verify ./build/$CIRCUIT/verification_key.json ./build/$CIRCUIT/public.json ./build/$CIRCUIT/proof.json && mkdir -p contracts/$CIRCUIT && snarkjs zkey export solidityverifier ./build/$CIRCUIT/circuit_final.zkey ./contracts/$CIRCUIT/verifier.sol && sed -i "s/contract Groth16Verifier/contract ${CIRCUIT}Verifier/" contracts/$CIRCUIT/verifier.sol
scripts.zk:full: npm run zk:prep && npm run zk:input && npm run zk:prove
scripts.zk:calldata: cd build/$CIRCUIT && snarkjs generatecall | sed '1s/^/[/; $s/$/]/' > calldata.json
scripts.zk:compile-deploy: rm -rf ./ignition/deployments/chain-* && npx hardhat compile && npx hardhat ignition deploy ignition/modules/VerifierModule.ts --network sepolia --verify
